notes.title: Snail Bob Winter Update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TgGWNIB.png[/img]

What better time to put up a winter update than in the middle of summer? Cool your puzzle urges with a brand new chapter in Snail Bob 2! 

[list][*]30 Brand new levels, bringing the total to 120!
[*]8 New achievements
[*]Free update to everyone!
[/list]

Go ahead and get back into Snail Bob!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/349760/Snail_Bob_2_Tiny_Troubles/
